observations: Photo 0: White truck cab with an orange lattice boom crane mounted on the rear. A large dark 'F' logo is visible on the side of the crane boom. A yellow loader is partially visible on the left. The truck is parked on dirt ground.

Photo 1: Side and front view of the same truck. The orange crane structure has hydraulic hoses and tanks. The front grille displays the Isuzu logo and lettering. A license plate is mounted on the front bumper.
Photo 2: Front view of the truck with the crane boom folded upwards. The Isuzu logo is visible on the grille. A green forklift is visible on the right, and a yellow loader on the left.
